rejectCriteria: forelimbs touching ground or reading as extra legs
six-legged silhouettes, duplicate arms, duplicate tails, or hidden feet
large raptor, Tyrannosaurus, Allosaurus, lizard, or sauropodomorph body drift
bird beak, feathers, wings, swan-like neck, or bulky monster theropod proportions
oversized hands, long dangling hook claws, fused toes, cropped tail, text, labels, logos, or watermarks
